analyst.summary: Quess Corp recently split into three separately listed companies, and what remains under the Quess Corp name is now purely its staffing and workforce-management business -- the largest in India. On a fair, apples-to-apples basis this remaining business is growing well, with double-digit revenue growth and profit up sharply in the latest quarter. Some of the scoring data used to screen this stock understates its growth because it compares today's smaller, focused business against a historical base that included businesses since spun off; correcting for that, we view this as a hold.
